---
title: "Phase 1 — DuckDB Ingestion"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(here)
```

## Keep BD in memory only

```{r connect}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = ":memory:")
```

### Create duckbd object

```{r load_table}
dbExecute(con,
  paste0(
    "CREATE TABLE framingham AS
     SELECT * FROM read_csv_auto('",
    here("data/raw/framingham.csv"),
    "')"
  )
)
```

### Check data has been logged correctly

```{r}
dbGetQuery(con, "PRAGMA table_info('framingham')")
```

### Query data

```{r}
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM framingham LIMIT 5")

dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT PERIOD, COUNT(*) FROM framingham GROUP BY PERIOD ORDER BY PERIOD")
```
### More query

```{r}
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT PERIOD, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(TRY_CAST(AGE AS DOUBLE)) AS mean_age, AVG(TRY_CAST(TOTCHOL AS DOUBLE)) AS mean_chol FROM framingham GROUP BY PERIOD ORDER BY PERIOD")
```

## disconnect bd from memory

```{r}
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```
